notes.title: Patch 2.0.7 coming!
notes.content:
Even though we're busy with our newly released game (if you haven't played it yet, what are you waiting for?), we keep on improving Line Simulator thanks to your feedback! 

----------------------
Line Simulator v2.0.7 changes

BUG FIXES

- On the mobile, it now says "Wine" with the wine and "Beer" with the beer. 
- The last spot in the queue is turned off until you finish putting everything in the basket.
- Corrected a typo in one of the posters.

notes.title: Rabbit Holes have arrived!
notes.content:
[b][h2]The rabbit holes are here to trick us with their secrets![/h2][/b]

Line Simulator is insanely crazy in all its features, and the easter eggs could not be less!

Find your way to the most delirious and surprising secrets you've ever encountered in a video game. But it won't be easy to win the prize of finding out what's inside... Do you want to try? 

Also, this update has fixed bugs and improved the general experience. Check out the changes!


____

Line Simulator v2.0.6 changes

BUG FIXES
- Some minor changes in rabbit hole 2
- Fixes in the final stage.
- Fixed a visual bug when giving the friend's picture.
- No longer see the teleport points through the walls
- Fixed a problem with the player's starting position in rabbit hole 1.
- Fixed a bug with the particles when grabbing some ducks.
- Some minor fixes at the airport.
- Resin mission fixed at level 5.

CHANGES/ADDITIONS
- Rabbit Holes
- Changed the default image displayed on mobile next to the current queue rumor description.
- A machine with ducks in level 1 has been removed.
- Some lights have been changed, for example in the pavilion 5 of level 4.

notes.title: Yes, another update!
notes.content:
Hello again! 
Another week, another update. This time we have refined and fixed some audio bugs and other features. 
We hope you enjoy it!

____

Line Simulator v2.0.5 changes

- The cafeteria furniture has been redone.
- Entrance to rabbit hole 2 fixed
- Bug with the duck in rabbit hole 1 fixed.
- Fridge door fixed
- Removed duck prize furniture in the supermarket.
- Soundtrack manager bug fixes

notes.title: We keep working!
notes.content:
Hello again!

We continue working hard on Line Simulator. This time we bring you fixes for the newly added achievements, compatibility fixes with other headsets and minor bugs.

Thanks for your support and enjoy!

----------------------
Line Simulator Version 2.0.4 Changes

Achievements fixed:
- Race achievement.
- Winning lottery ticket.
- Hidden achievement.
- Get all the ducks.

BUG FIXES
- Bugs with the bottle solved.
- Objects floating in level 3.
- Error when hitting people with the finger.
- Lines to enter pavilion 1.

CHANGES/ADDITIONS
- Compatibility with HTC Vive Pro

notes.title: The achievements are coming to the line!
notes.content:
You asked and we listened. Line Simulator now has achievements!

In this major update we have fixed small bugs that the community has reported to us and we have also added a feature that many were waiting for. More than twenty funny and crazy achievements for you to enjoy queuing in every way!

You’ll be surprised how many things you can do while waiting to buy bread ːsteammockingː

Here are the different fixes and changes in this update, and don’t forget that during this winter sales Line Simulator is 50% off!

---------

Line Simulator Version 2.0.3 Changes

BUG FIXES

- Fixed a bug at the airport that caused some people to walk on the site.
- Now there is an arc in the battle.
- The teleport points have been modified to make it easier to detect if you have entered, also now they are all the same size.
- The teleport points are always visible.
- Fixed the color of the messages in the cell phone and the bug.
- The alarm of the cell phone is deactivated when you grab it.
- Different settings and visual improvements in level 1.
- The pocket with the suitcase in the airport has been moved to a more accessible place.

CHANGES/ADDITIONS

- Achievements have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37760632/ae79d73c6b6ee59f33ec7295ed6dd37bb2e65c3e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Line Simulator v2.0.2 - Fix changelog
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We are constantly improving and refining Line Simulator to make the experience crazy fun for everyone. 
These are the changes we have worked on during this last patch:

[h2]Line Simulator v2.0.2[/h2]
- The luggage slot has been relocated, now is easier to see and manipulate.
- The phone alarm now shuts down when you grab it.
- The teleport points now are always visible.
- The teleport points colliders that detect if you entered inside have been increased.
- Completed quests now appears in orange on the phone
- The background city of Level 1 has been rebuilt.
- Fixed some Level 1 objects' behavior.
- Fixed transparency on some Level 1 objects.
- Some life added to Level 1 city.
- Fixed phone's behavior when grabbing it.
- Fixes on level 2 scenario.
- Fixes on Duckwoman animations and behavior.
- Fixed a bug that altered significantly the pitch of some shopkeepers from the convention.
- Soundtrack remake.

[h3]Remember that you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/3DypBpsJNH]discord [/url]and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/WrongRealityVR]Twitter[/url] to keep up to date with the latest news.[/h3]

[h3]Thanks for your infinite support and patience! [/h3]

notes.title: Line Simulator finally has a great update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Finally, the day has arrived! [/b][/h1]

After countless battles against bugs that cost us time, money, and many pizzas, [h3][b]Line Simulator[/b] finally has a great update![/h3]

It's been a long road to get here, and it's been a big challenge as our first development, but we appreciate you for sticking it out with us. Making a queue waiting game only works if there are people who can queue, so we knew we had to build a huge environment full of NPC's with their own life lives in order to give movement and energy to the game.

It has not been easy to balance and develop this for our team, but we have finally achieved it and we want to give you, the players, a sample of what we can really do as creators, trying our best and putting all the love and care into making this a good game that makes the player laugh.
You can check the changelog of fixes in the community hub, and don't forget to join our discord!

[h3]We would like to thank our entire [b]community for supporting us along the way and patiently waiting for the game to be ready[/b][/h3]

We wouldn't be here without your support and feedback to improve ourselves as people and studio.
Thank you so much for supporting us and we hope you enjoy [b]Line Simulator[/b] in all its glory!! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37760632/7aeaeb4c8cb9c041524f5796b0eead4f68f912de.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Overhaul Patch Coming To Line Simulator!
notes.content:
You asked, gave feedback, and we listened; we're going to be coming out with a major overhaul patch that fixes headset compatibility, glitches, bugs, animations, voiceovers, it's all getting a major overhaul, we haven't forgotten about you!

Within the month the first patch will be released with the second content patch coming out. All free, all for you!

Stay awesome, be sure to join our Discord, and let's keep waiting and show the world that it can be great again!

<3 Team Stracos

notes.title: Hotfix - Oculus Quest
notes.content: A hotfix to address the Oculus Link feature is being pushed to Steam. Some users who are using the beta feature from Oculus noted the compatibility issue. We are working on other updates coming in a patch note that includes other minor fixes and updates to things like audio levels, headset compatibility and more!

notes.title: Line Simulator Demo — Imminent Demo Release
notes.content:
[b]We want to improve our user experience with your feedback![/b]

Some things that would really help us are as follows:
[list]
[*] Try out our demo and give us your feedback and criticism
[*] Write up and publish how you felt about our Demo experience (Don't forget to share it with us to be featured on the Media page of our website once it goes live this week!)
[*] Live stream your gameplay! (Again, let us know when you do this so we can grab some popcorn and pull up a front row seat for the show. If the video is saved, we'll also feature this on our Media page!)
[*] Play our game and reach out with any questions or comments you'd like our Creative and/or Development teams to address.
[*] Join our new [url=https://discord.gg/jqkT7aq]Discord Community[/url] (and invite your friends!) to join in the daily discourse. You'll also receive live updates straight from our team!
[*] Feel free to check out and post to our [url=https://www.facebook.com/stracosllc/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/StracosLLC]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/stracosllc/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.linkedin.com/company/stracos-ltd/]LinkedIn[/url]!
[/list]
For our team here at Stracos, Line Simulator isn't just a game. It's an act of defiance. We're a small collective of talent and brilliance that was told we would never make it in this industry.

[b]Our response? No way, Jose![/b]

We self fund under the Stracos umbrella as a boutique venture investment and technology consultative firm and pour our passion and drive into video game and AI/VR/AR solution design and implementation. We have never done this before, so we're leaving it up to passionate gamers like you to help us. This team is willing to fail until we get this right, and Line Simulator is the first in a long line of passion projects we plan to launch and update over the next decade.

Will you be the next page in our success story? We hope so.
